How many times have you consulted a doctor about cancer in the last year - at age 43 years
cat_rows: This category contains data from the questionnaires on cancer (self reported). Data was collected in 1982 (age 36 years), 1989 (age 43 years), 1999 (age 53 years), 2006-10 (age 60-64 years) and 2015 (age 69 years). Information includes ICD codes and age of cancer, whether medicine was prescribed.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
